propositions: BindingStore's 799-line module owns byte persistence, lifecycle, retirement, recovery, and rotation policy with no cohesive ownership; production code mutates inner entries via shallow all_bindings() compatibility query

Decomposition must extract three internal owners—a byte-preserving repository/unit-of-work, lifecycle policy, and recovery—behind a single unchanged public facade while preserving unknown fields and exact JSON behavior
Durable tombstone-based retirement completion rule: a live forward/reverse pair is removed only when tombstone, forward, and reverse identities all agree; only explicit unretire revokes that intent
Live recovery must run after staleness validation but complete exact-match interrupted retirements before remote issue observation to prevent interleaving new liveness evidence with completion

Automatic liveness signals (404 grace, same-key confirm, 200 clear_absent) cannot revoke a durable tombstone; recovery writes occur only in validated write-bearing operations, not during load/check/dry-run/preview/selection/filtered paths
